title: Possible Lz Values
description: Essential Criteria: Identify the possible results of Lz as +hbar and 0.

title: Probability Calculation
description: Important Criteria: Correctly calculate the probabilities for Lz = +hbar and Lz = 0 as 2/3 and 1/3 respectively.

title: Expectation Value
description: Essential Criteria: Compute the expectation value of Lz as (2/3)hbar.

title: Normalization Check
description: Important Criteria: Verify that the wave function is normalized to 1.

title: Integration Limits
description: Pitfall Criteria: Avoid errors in setting the limits of integration for angular variables.

title: Wave Function Form
description: Optional Criteria: Recognize the correct form of the wave function in terms of spherical harmonics.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that all probabilities and expectation values are expressed with correct units.
